Compute school- and district-level demographic composition and shifts

Source: R/aggregate_helpers.R
compute_population_shifts.Rd

Tracks how the demographic composition of the tested population changes over time at the school and district level, and examines whether composition shifts correlate with proficiency changes.

Usage

compute_population_shifts(
  data,
  performance_data,
  spec,
  school_data = NULL,
  min_n_school = 10
)

Arguments

data

A long-format student results data frame.

performance_data

Named list returned by compute_performance_trends().

spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

school_data

school_results_long data frame, or NULL. When NULL, co-op and locale breakdowns are set to NULL.

min_n_school

Integer. Minimum school size for inclusion. Default 10.

Value

A named list:

  • $school_demographic_composition — long format: school × year × group × pct

  • $district_demographic_composition — long format: district × year × group × pct

  • $demographic_trend_slopes — school × group: slope over years

  • $composition_proficiency_join — school × year: delta_composition columns and delta_pct_proficient for each subject

  • $by_coop — NULL (requires school_results_long)

  • $by_locale — NULL (requires school_results_long)
